tei:div.tei:p: (āḥ)༄༅// nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len nag 'gros gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hī ye/ 'dir rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs rnal 'byor bcu gcig stan thog gcig tu nyams su blang tshul bshad pa dang mtha' dpyod sogs spangs te mdor bsdus te 'chad pa la bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gros bka'i gnang ba stsal du gsol/ de la rnal 'byor bcu gcig ni sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying pos/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myang*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis rlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes gsungs pa'i dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la gnyis las/ dang po gang zag spros pa la mi dga' bas bsam mi khyab rgyas bsdus gang yin sgom rjes rnam rtog gis bar ma chod par stong nyid kyi ngang du nyal/ gnyis pa spros pa la dga' bas gnas khang chos 'byung dmar po 'od kyi rang bzhin du gsal ba'i nang du seṅge'i khri la rang rnal 'byor ma rgyan dang phyag mtshan med pa zhig nyal ba'i mgo bo'i thad du seṅge'i khrir rtsa ba'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam par bzhugs pa la mos gus bya zhing rnam rtog gis bar ma chod par nyal lo// gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ tho rengs kyi char nam mkhar mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis ḍā ma ru'i sgra dang oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyi sgra lhang lhang bsgrags pa'i rkyen gyis gnyid sad de nyal lugs kyi sngon ma stong nyid kyi ngang du nyal na/ chu las nya 'phar ba ltar rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa'i skur lam gyis ldang*/

nyal lugs phyi ma ltar na rang rnal 'byor ma dang sngas 'go'i bla ma gnas khang chos 'byung sogs gsal btab/ grogs yod na de yang rnal 'byor mar gsal btab/ bla ma de la mos gus byas pas 'od du zhu rang la thim pas rang yang lhar shin tu gsal bar gyur par bsam mo// gsum pa bdud rtsi myong ba ni/ bdud rtsi dngos yod na oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis g.yon bskor du chos 'byung bris pa'i dbus nas bdud rtsi blangs te lce la bzhag bdud rtsi dngos su med kyang yid kyis bsam ste/ myang ba'i tshul byas pas lus kyi nang thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis mer gyis khengs pas sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dag bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skyed/ bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma thams cad rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig dmar po de la thim pas gzi 'od dang ldan par gyur te rnal 'byor ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres par bsam la brjod med kyi ngang du cham me bzhag go /bzhi pa tshad med nas lam dngos ston pa la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum gyi/ sngon 'gro la bzhi/ skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ yig brgya/ maṇ+ḍal dang bzhi'o// de'i dang por skyabs 'gro ni/ gnas khang tha mal pa ma yin pa gzhi yongs su dag pa bai ḍūr+ya'i sa gzhi la/ gser zhun mig mangs ris su bres pa/ mnan na nems byed cing*/ btegs na spar byed pa/ reg na bde ba skye ba/ de'i dbus rang gi mdun thad du seṅge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa skyabs gsum kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid du gsal btab/ rang gi g.yas su pha g.yon du ma/ mdun du gnod byed kyi dgra 'dre/ mtha' kun rigs drug gi sems can bar do dang bcas pa khrom tshogs pa ltar gsal btab la kha tsam ma yin par/ snying khong rus pa'i gting nas skyabs 'gro bzhi skor ngag 'don ltar ci nus byas pa'i mthar thal mo sbyar te skyabs gsol tshar gcig brjod pas/

bla ma'i sku las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi 'khor du yod pa'i sems can de rnams la phog pas sgrib gnyis byang tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sems rtog med chos kyi sku dang*/ lus zag med rnal 'byor ma 'ba' zhig tu gyur te bya khyu 'phur ba bzhin mkha' spyod du song*/ bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim par bsam nas brjod med du bzhag go /gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ zhes sogs lan gsum brjod pas smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed do// gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas zur nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal ni/ lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba ste/ de la yang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ thun mong ma yin pa logs su gsal/ 'dir thun mong ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du zhes sogs dkyus ltar gsal btab nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma ci rigs 'bul/ spro na ku sā la'i tshogs gsog thun mong ma yin pa ltar bya/ skabs 'dir brgyud 'debs byas kyang chog dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma 'od du zhu spyi bo nas rang la thim par bsam la bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag drug pa bdag lhar bskyed pa bdag gi gzhi sbyang bsgyur ni/ rang gi snying khar e e las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zhes pa nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar ngag 'don ltar brjod/ de'i go don gzhan go sla la chos 'byung gru gsum de bsgom tshul snying gar e nyis brtsegs dmar po yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung dmar po rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/

gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa zur gcig mdun du bstan pa'i nang du chos 'byung gnyis pa bcug pa'i zur gsum chos 'byung phyi ma'i logs gsum du bstan pa/ de'i dbus su zla ba/ de'i dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po zla ba'i kha mtshams la oṃ gsum ma'i sngags phreng dmar po g.yon skor du 'khod pa las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'phros pas lus thams cad gang bas sdig sgrib nyes ltung dang rnam smin gdos bcas kyi lus sbyangs te/ lus 'od phung du gyur pa ni bdag gi gzhi sbyang ba dang*/ bsgyur ba ni rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gsal 'debs pa'o// de lta bu'i mngon rtogs kyang dkyus bzhin/ do shal ni thod rlon lnga bcu yin no// rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga'i spyi bor 'khor lo'i steng du rigs bdag rnam snang he ru ka dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rus rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum zhig gsal 'debs pa ngag 'don la med pas ma chad pa gal che'o// gdan gyi dus mtshan ma dang 'jigs byed gnyis ka gri thod 'dzin pa'am 'jigs byed phyag mtshan med pa thal mo sbyar ba'ang rung ngo*// bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang sgyur ni/ ngag 'don gyi yi ge dkrugs pa 'dir sdebs na/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros te ba spu'i bu ga nas phar song rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ de thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur zhes pa'o// brgyad pa dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis rlabs pa ye shes pa dgug gzhug ni/ phaiṃ zhes 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar g.yon du lan gsum bskor/ rang gi snying kha'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la/ zhes pa nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ'i bar gyis ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya/

pad kor 'khyud rgya dang bcas te oṃ yo ga shud+dho sogs lan gsum brjod/ 'di la pho nya gsum bsres/ zhes gsungs pas/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bskyed pa dang*/ 'gro ba thams cad rnal 'byor mar gyur pa bdag gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang bsgyur ni sngags skyes/ 'dzam bu gling gi yul nyer bzhir bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams ni zhing skyes/ 'og min na bzhugs pa rnams ni lhan skyes te/ de gsum gcig tu bsres pas pho nya gsum bsre zhes bya'o// skabs 'dir lus dkyil spro na bsgom/ go cha bcing ba dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs pa dngos ni/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo zhes pa nas phaṭa phaṭa dud ka tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo'o// zhes pa'i bar ro// de yang yi ge 'bru gnyis ni dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i ngo bo yin la/ tshigs chen brgyad ni lag pa'i dpung pa gnyis dang mkhrig ma gnyis/ dpyi mgo gnyis dang rkang pa'i bol gnyis dang kha ni lce'i dkyil du'o// dgu pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis te/ ngag bzlas dang*/ yid bzlas so// dang po ngag bzlas ni/ rang gi snying gar chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs zhes pa nas/ byin gyis brlab par gyur gyi bar ngag 'don du brjod rjes/ oṃ gsum ma bzla ba'o// gnyis pa yid bzlas ni/ lus gnad drang por bsrangs pa'i ngang nas rlung ro gsum sangs kyis bus/ 'og rlung phyed 'then tsam byas rjes/ steng rlung dal bus rngubs te rdzogs pa dang*/ mchil ma gcig mid pa dang mnyam du lte 'og tu ldigs kyis bskyur bas snying ga'i chos 'byung sngags phreng bam̐ yig dang bcas pa lte bar khrig ge sleb par bsam la/ slar 'og rlung rdzogs par 'then nas cher gyis mnan pa'i 'og rlung kha sbyor du byed pa lam 'di'i lugs yin la/ de'i tshe lte ba'i sngags phreng rnams yid kyis klog pa'i tshul byas te ji tsam thub kyi bar du rlung mnan mi thub pa dang*/

rang 'gros su phyir nar gyis btang la ngal bso/ ngag 'don las/ snying ga'i chos 'byung zla ba'i yig 'bru dang bcas pa bde ba skye bar 'dod na gsang gnas/ mi rtog pa skye bar 'dod na lte bar phab/ ces gsungs kyang lte bar phab pa kho na gal che/ de'i rjes su zhar byung gi rdzogs rim ni/ slar yang rlung kha sbyor sngar bzhin bzung la/ lte 'og gi chos 'byung snol ma de'i mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' 'khyil dmar po bzhi g.yon skor du drag tu myur ba dmar khyil le le 'khor ba la sems gtad de 'dzin med du 'jog yang rlung phyir bus sngar bzhin rlung bzung ba'am/ yang na rlung ma bzung na gang bde byas la/ rang lus 'od kyi rang bzhin dmar khro ba de'i lus kyi nang dbus rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar ba rgyu ma phus btab pa lta bu rtsa ba gsang gnas su zug pa/ yas sna spyi bo nas sba gug ltar smin mtshams su zug pa bug pa ha re yod pa/ de'i mas snar dga' 'khyil dmar po nas tsam zhig g.yon skor 'khyil re 'khor ba/ yas sna smin mtshams su zug pa'i nang du dga' 'khyil dkar po nas tsam zhig g.yon skor du 'khor ba gsal btab/ thog mar mas sna'i dga' 'khyil dmar po de/ dbu ma'i nang nas yar bya 'phur ba bzhin dmar khor ro ro song bas snang ba thams cad bde cham cham song ste snying ga'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du sleb cing drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad/ yang yas sna'i smin mtshams kyi dga' 'khyil dkar po de smin mtshams nas spyi bo'i bar du gyen la khor ro ro song ste spyi gtsug nas dbu ma'i nang du bya nam mkha' babs pa ltar skya bo ro ro babs pas snang ba thams cad stong cham cham song snying thad kyi dga' 'khyil dmar po'i steng reg la ma 'byar tsam du dga' 'khyil dkar dmar gnyis ka g.yon skor du 'khyil le le 'khor ba la sems gtad/ mthar dga' 'khyil gnyis ka phrug gis 'dres nas kha dog dkar po la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa 'od zer gyi rang bzhin g.yon skor du myur bar 'khor ba la sems gtad pas/

je yal la song dbu ma'i stong pa dang gnyis med du song bar bsams la rig pa brjod med du ci gnas bzhag go /bcu pa bsam mi khyab yin kyang*/ skabs 'dir dbu mar rlung sems la bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor mar dbu ma kha dbye ba bsgom pa ni/ lus rnam snang chos bdun bcas la/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus thams cad 'od kyi rang bzhin dmar khral le ba de'i dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma sbom phra mda' smyug 'bring po tsam yar sna tshangs bug dang mar sna gsang gnas kyi rtser zug pa chos bzhi ldan zhes til gyi mar me ltar gsal ba/ rgya skyegs ltar dmar ba/ chu shing ltar drang ba/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar srab pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo dang g.yon rkyang ma dkar mo gnyis sbom phra gro sog tsam dbu ma dang mnyam par gshibs pa'i yar sna tshangs bug nas 'khyogs te sna bug gnyis su ha re zug par mar sna dbu ma dang mnyam du zug pa/ lte ba'i thad du ro rkyang dbu gsum sbubs gcig tu gyur pa stong sang nge ba de'i nang du yi ge bam̐ dmar nag drod kyi rang bzhin ril ma tsam zhig bsam/ de nas sna bug g.yon nas rlung ro sangs kyis bus/ de nas g.yas/ de nas gnyis ka nas bus/ de 'dra lan gsum steng rlung dgu phrugs su sangs kyis bus/ de rjes 'og rlung phyed 'then zhing steng rlung nar gyis rngubs pa lte 'og tu chir gyis mnan/ rjes 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gsum tsam byas te 'og rlung rdzogs par 'then pa lte bar kha sbyar te bzung bas/ rlung des ram̐ la bus pas ram̐ me dmar hur gyis song bas rtsa sbubs dmar ding nge drod tsha hu re ba la sems gtad de 'dzin med du cham me bzhag mi thub pa dang*/ sangs kyis btang la slar yang sngar bzhin bzung bas/ ram̐ me 'bar ba'i drod kyis lus kyi rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis ba spu bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i rtsa nang na gnas pa'i khams snyigs ma thams cad cham cham skam/

dwangs ma rnams thig ler zhu ro rkyang gnyis kyi nang nas mar bde chil le le babs pas lte ba'i rtsa gsum sbubs gcig tu gyur pa de nyid mer gyis khengs 'og rlung cung zad 'then pas ro rkyang gnyis kyi mar sna dbu ma'i nang zhugs te thig le thams cad dbu ma'i nang nas yar chil gyis song*/ spyi bo nas gsang gnas bar gyi dbu ma'i nang thams cad khams dkar po dngul chu dwangs pa'i mdog lta bus ltem gyis gang ba la sems gtad de rig pa 'dzin med du bzhag nas/ rlung 'dzin pa ni dbu mar rlung sems bsdu ba'am dbu ma kha dbye ba'am gtum mo'i rnal 'byor yin no// de rjes rlung lus la gnas pa bde ba bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ sems la zhugs pa stong pa bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po bde ba sgrub pa ni/ ro rkyang gnyis dang dbu ma'i nang gi thig le 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur/ dbu ma kho na yar sne spyi bo nas sba gug pa ltar 'khyogs pa smin mtshams su har re zug pa'i nang du chos 'byung gru gsum dmar ser nge ba gdengs ka che ba smin mtshams su bstan cing rtsa ba phra ba dbu ma'i nang du zug pa la bug pa thal le yod pa gdengs ka che ba de'i nang du thig le kha dog lnga gcig tu 'dres pa khra khrug khrug pa 'od 'phro ba sran chung tsam bde ba'i rang bzhin 'od du hril le yod pa zhig la sems gtad de rlung bum pa can sngar ltar gzung bas thig le de smin mtshams nas gyen du hril le le song*/ spyi gtsug gi thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du ri rtser skar ma shar ba ltar 'od hril le le byed pa la sems gtad/ thig le de'i khrod nas bde chen gyi rang bzhin thig le shel dkar zhu ba'i khu ba lta bu sbom phra dar skud tsam zhig skya nar gyis babs/ dbu ma'i nang nas mar bde khril le song mgrin snying lte ba rnams brgyud mthar gsang gnas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbyibs can gyi dbus dbu ma'i mas snar chos 'byung dmar po gdengs ka che ba thur la bstan cing rtsa ba phra ba dbu ma'i nang du zug pa de'i nang nas mar thal gyis song bas gsang gnas kyi pad+ma'i phyir sor phyed gsum tsam nyug ge yod pa la sems gtad nas rig pa brjod med du bzhag

de ltar byas pas bde ba mi bzod pa skyes na sor do sor gang sogs yang rim bzhin bsdus pas gegs sel lo// gnyis pa stong pa bsgrub pa ni/ rlung 'dzin pa'am ma bzung kyang rung ste/ smin mtshams su thig le bsgoms pa sogs sngar ltar la/ thig le de spyi gtsug tu hril le gnas pa de las 'od kha dog lnga ldan 'ja' tshon lta bu bun gyis 'phros/ de gang reg pa'i lus thams cad spyi bo nas rim bzhin 'od kha dog lnga ldan 'ja' tshon lta bur yal la song*/ de las 'od 'phros phyi snang snod bcud thams cad 'od kha dog lnga ldan du bun gyis song ba la sems gtad/ rig pa brjod med du bzhag 'od de dag nam mkhar yal gyis song ba'am/ yang na tshur 'dus rang la thim/ rang gi spyi bo'i thig le la thim/ de yang 'ja' yal bar bsam dgos par gsungs/ 'on kyang 'di nyid kho na bsgom na de ltar byas kyang chog mod/ bsam mi khyab de ma thag tu bsgom dgos pas snod bcud thams cad 'od lnga ldan du bun gyis song ba la sems gtad nas brjod med du bzhag pas 'thus/ bcu pa bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor la gnyis las/ dang po thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab ni zur du shes la/ gnyis pa thun mong ba'i bsam mi khyab ni ngag 'don las/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum thams cad khyab/ ces pa nas/ de je phra je phra las mi dmigs par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar ltar ro// de'i ngang las rang rje btsun ma'i skur gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs sh+lau ka gnyis dang*/ mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam sogs dkyus ltar ro// bcu gcig pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la dngos dang*/ yan lag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang rnal 'byor ma'i skur langs te dge ba bsngos rjes phyi rol gyi gzugs mthong ba thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i sku dang*/ rna bas sgra thos tshad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung sngags kyi sgra dang*/

dran rtog gang shar thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs bde stong dbyer med du shes par byas la ma yengs par bskyangs pa 'di gal che bas dran 'dzin drag pos spyod lam thams cad du ma yengs par bya ba gnad che'o// gnyis pa yan lag lnga yod pa gzhan rnams khrid yig ltar la/ rgyun du mkho ba kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor gnyis gal che bas kha zas kyi rnal 'byor la/ rgyas/ 'bring*/ bsdus gsum las/ rgyas par bdud rtsi byin rlabs ltar kha zas bza' btung gang yin byin rlabs byas/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lte ba nas gtum mo ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i khrod nas snying ga nas bla ma yi dam thams cad bzhugs pa la mchod par bsam pas kha hom khung lag pa gnyis dgang gzar blugs gzar kha zas bdud rtsir gyur pa de phul bas snying ga'i lha rnams kyis bzhes par bsam la 'dzin zhen med par longs spyod/ 'bring du oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥzhes lan gsum gyis byin rlabs nas snying ga'i bam̐ yig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo de nyid mchod par bsam/ bsdus pa rang dang kha zas gnyis ka rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsams la lha la lha thim pa'i tshul gyis longs spyod/ de ltar kha zas kyi rnal 'byor longs spyod na dkor dang bu lon du mi 'gyur zhing bde stong gi ye shes skye ba'i grogs su 'gyur ba yin gsung ngo*// gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni mngon rtogs kyi ngag 'don ltar ro// gzhan thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi khrid yig la bla ma'i zhal shes kyis brgyan pa ltar nyams su blang ngo*// de ltar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len nag 'gros kyi tshul du mdor bsdus te bris pa gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba 'di ni nye gnas pad+ma phan bdes bskul ngor/ dge slong bya bral pa pad+ma phrin las kyi rang lo bdun cu'i thog tu bris pa bdag gzhan mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i nye lam chen por gyur cig/

༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod kyi zab gnad snying por bsdus pa mthong ba rab gsal bzhugs so// ༈ /na maḥshrī badz+ra gu ra we/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po dang gnyis su med pa rje btsun rdo rje btsun mo mkha' spyod dbang mo'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'dir rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs nyams su len pa/ khrid yig gi rim pa shin tu mang bas rgyas par bri ma dgos kyang bsgom bya'i gnad 'ga' zhig btus te bshad pa ni/ spyi don dang po sgrub rten gyi gang zag des bsgrub pa'i lam dngos/ lam des 'grub pa'i 'bras bu gsum las/ dang po la gnyis te/ smin lam la 'jug rung gi gang zag dang*/ grol lam bsgom rung gi gang zag gnyis so// dang po ni/ spyir bde kye sogs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'am/ khyad par 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gang rung gi dbang thob pa ni smin lam 'jug rung gi gang zag go /gnyis pa ni/ gang zag de lta bus rang gi sgo gsum gdod ma nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs yin pa la ngo sprod pa'i thabs su sku tshom bu gsung bdud rtsi thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs legs par thob cing chag med du nyams su len par 'dod pa ni grol lam sgom rung gi gang zag go /spyi don gnyis pa des bsgrub pa'i lam dngos ni/ rab kyis bsgom bzlas chag med dang gzhi bsnyen mthar phyin yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu la brtson par byas pas ji zhig na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal bud med kyi rnam pa dngos su byon nas rnal 'byor pa de'i lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod 'khrid par byed/ 'bring des de ltar nyams su blangs pas rtags ma byung na/ bsnyen pa yi ge'i grangs kyi 'bru 'bum tshar gnyis tsam bzlas pa'i mthar/

laṅka li ya'i shing la brten nas sin+dhū ra'i sgrub mchod dang man ngag la brten pa'i las la sbyar bas/ mkha' spyod ma mi mo'i gzugs kyi dpral bar sin+dhū ra 'phos pa des sngar bzhin lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste mkha' spyod du 'khrid par byed/ tha ma rab 'bring gi rtags de lta bu ma byung yang sgyid lug mi bya bar sgom bzlas la nan tan du byas pas nam zhig 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku las bar dor langs pa'i tshe/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pas rnal 'byor pa de seṅge'i khri la bzhag cing 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang me tog gi char rol mo'i tshogs dang bcas te mkha' spyod du khrid par byed nges pa'o// shin tu tha ma skye ba brgyud nas dngos grub thob pa smon lam gyi lam zhes grags so// de ltar nyams su len pa la bskyed rim bzlas pa dang bcas pa rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi rim pa ni/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myang*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes gsungs pas/ 'di la bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa bskyed rim dang*/ bcad don nyams su len pa sems 'dzin gnyis las/ dang po bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i bskyed rim la/ dang por nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la gnyis kyi dang po gang zag spros pa la mi dga' ba stong nyid la mos pa la/ bsam mi khyab thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gang rung gi mthar rnam rtog gis bar ma chod pa stong nyid kyi ngang du nyal ba ni/ rang bzhin lhan skyes stong pa'i ngang la nyal ba'o// gnyis pa spros pa la dga' ba bskyed rim la mos pa la/

gnas khang chos 'byung dmar po 'od kyi rang bzhin can gyi nang du rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan dang phyag mtshan med pa'i mgo bo'i thad du seṅge'i khri la bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam par bzhugs par mos te mos gus drag pos gsol ba dung dung 'debs shing*/ bla ma'i sku dang rang lhar gsal ba gnyis yang yang gsal 'debs pa las/ rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par nyal ba ni/ zhu bde lhan skyes bde ba'i ngang la nyal ba'o// de'i sbyang gzhi snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa/ bcud kyi sems can 'chi ba rang gzhan thams cad gti mug gi dbang gis dud 'gro ltar gnyid log pa thams cad sbyong byed nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyi rnam par bsgyur bas/ sbyangs 'bras dag snang gi rgyas btab ste bsgom pas 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mngon du byed pa'o// gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor yang nyal lugs gnyis yod pa ltar ldang lugs kyang gnyis su 'byung ste/ thog mar tho rangs kyi cha la nam mkha' las mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis ḍā ma ru'i sgra khrol lo lo grags pa'i sgra de bde mchog gi yi ge bdun ma dang nye snying oṃ gsum ma sogs kyi sgra lhang lhang grags pa'i rkyen gyis gnyid sad de nyal lugs snga ma ltar na stong nyid/ de'i ngang las chu las nya 'phar ba ltar rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa'i skur lam gyis ldang zhing*/ phyi ma ltar rang lhar gsal ba dang*/ gnas khang bla ma sogs nyal dus ltar gsal btab cing*/ grogs yod kyang rnal 'byor mar gsal btab/ bla ma la mos gus byas pas 'od du zhu rang la thim pas rang sngar bas kyang gsal bar bsam/ de'i sbyang gzhi snod kyi 'jig rten chags pa bcud kyi sems can skye ba/ rang gzhan thams cad la gnyid sad pa'i snang ba bun long du shar ba sbyong byed ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis sbyong bar byed pa yin no// ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyi gnyid sad rkyen ḍā ma ru'i sgra sogs goms 'dris chung bas gsal thebs dka' bas gnyid sad phral du de ltar gsal 'debs bya bar bshad/

gsum pa bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ bdud rtsi ril bu dngos sam chang la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa'am/ ma 'byor na dmigs pas kyang rung ste/ slar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes byin gyis brlabs te/ dngos su yod na g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blangs te myang bas lus nang bdud rtsis khengs pas sdig sgrib dag cing bde chen gyi ye shes skyes/ bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim pas gzi 'od dang ldan par gyur te/ rang sems dang rnal 'byor ma'i thugs dbyer med du 'dres pa'i ngang la brjod med du bzhag 'di'i sbyang gzhi rang gzhan thams cad bza' btung dang khrus byed pa/ mu stegs rnams lus bkrus pas sems kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba'i log lta/ nyan thos pa kha'i dri ma dag phyir khrus byed pa sogs nyams len gyis rtsis ma zin pas/ sangs rgyas thob rgyur mi 'gro bas/ de rnams sbyong byed bdud rtsi myang ba'i rnal 'byor 'dis sbyangs pas sbyangs 'bras dag snang gis rgyas btab ste bsgoms pas 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mngon du byed par gsungs/ de bzhin du rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i nyams len gyi snying po dga' ba gsum yang 'dir 'dus te rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba sku'i dga' ba/ bdud rtsi mgrin pa nas myangs bas bde chen gyi ye shes skye ba gsung gi dga' ba/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig dang rang sems dbyer med du bzhag pa thugs kyi dga' ba ste gsum yang 'dus so// bzhi pa tshad med la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi dang po sngon 'gro la skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ yig brgya/ maṇ+ḍal dang bzhir yod pa bsgom tshul khrid yig rnams su gsal ba ltar dang*/ khyad par du lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis su yod pa gang rung dang*/ maṇ+ḍal sbyar na legs te/ maṇ+ḍal 'chad dus zhal shes gsum// zhal shes dang po bla ma bsgom// zhal shes gnyis pa dbang bzhi blang*// zhal shes gsum pa bla ma bstim// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/

zhal shes dang po ji ltar bsgom pa ni/ thun mong ba tshar chen rin po che'i gsung 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i khrid yig dang ngag 'don du gsal ba ltar/ thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa ltar bsgoms na legs pas 'di ltar/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dag gsal gnyis su med pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs sogs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su seṅge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sangs rgyas rdo rje chos sam rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril thugs khar bsnol te 'dzin pa dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ dar dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i pad 'dab kyi kha mtshams nas g.yon skor du/ rdo rje chos/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub chen nā ro ta pa nas bzung ste rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa sku mdog dmar po g.yas ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thugs khar 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa sogs ngag 'don du yod pa ltar brjod cing gsal btab la gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma gnod sbyin nor lha dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur/ skyabs gnas de 'dra re re la skyabs gnas cha tshang ba re re thim song snyam du bsam la/

gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// ces sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang*/ sangs rgyas rdo rje chos la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sogs so so'i mtshan sbyar ba rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byed/ mi spro na/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje chos// zhes sogs kyi brgyud 'debs byas pas 'thus/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so// khyed rang rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sogs tshar gang mang dang*/ bsdu na tshar gsum gyis gsol ba phur tshugs su btab/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul bar gsungs pas/ bdag gzhan gyi lus longs spyod thams cad rgyur byas pa'i rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo nyer spyod sogs mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa nam mkha' gang ba spros te phul bas mchod yul rnams mnyes shing lha mo rnams rang la thim pas phyi mchod/ yang snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo thod pa thogs pa dpag med spros pa'i thod pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dag pa ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsis gang ba bla ma re re la phul bas ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gsol bas zag med kyi bde bas mnyes par byas te lha mo rnams rang la thim pa nang mchod/ yang rang gi snying ga nas lha mo pad+ma can sogs dpag tu med pa glu len gar bsgyur ba spros pa rnams gcig la gcig thim pa mthar rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur te bla ma rnams la thim nas snyoms 'jug gi bde bas mnyes par bsam pa ni gsang mchod/ mchod mkhan mchod yul mchod tshul thams cad gang du yang ma grub par 'dzin med la blo bzhag pa ni de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o// ku sā li'i tshogs gsog ni/ rang sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam zhig lus dbus drang po nas rtsa dbu ma'i lam brgyud spyi bo nas rgyangs te thon/

des rang lus la gzigs pas tsho ba/ snum pa che zhing brjid pa zhig khrang nge gnas pa de'i rtsar byon/ phyag g.yas gri gug gis rang lus kyi thod pa lings kyis bkog nas mdun du thod pa'i sgyed bu ri rab tsam gsum grub pa'i steng du bkal te/ de la cher gzigs pas je cher song ste mthar stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam par gyur/ de nas rnal 'byor ma des rang lus de'i rkang pa g.yon dum bu gsum du bcad nas thod pa'i nang du bskyur/ de bzhin du rkang g.yas lag g.yon lag g.yas lus bshags nas stod smad kyi nang khrol/ de nas ro smad/ ro stod sogs lhag ma med par dum bur byas te bskyur bas/ sha'i ri bo khrag gi rgya mtsho rus pa'i gram khrod chen por gyur pa de la thugs gtad nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pas thod pa'i 'og tu yam̐ las rlung ljang gu gzhu'i dbyibs can dang*/ ram̐ las me gsum yod pa la rlung g.yos te/ me rlung gi sbyor bas bskol bas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dkar po reg bya bsil ba nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed nus par bsam ste/ rang sems rnal 'byor mar gsal ba de'i snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo thod pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ de rnams kyis thod nang gi bdud rtsi nas bcus te gtso bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos su gsal ba de la phul bas ljags 'od zer sbu gus gsol bas mnyes par byas te mchod lha rang la thim/ de ltar lan bdun spros te phul ba kha sbyor yan lag bdun thob pa'i rten 'brel yin gsungs/ de bzhin du mchod lha spros te brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la bdud rtsi'i thod pa re re phul zhing lha mo rnams rang la thim par bsam/ skabs 'dir spro na/ bla ma re re'i mtshan la 'bru gsum sbyar bas mchod pa ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐

zhes pa lta bu'o// bsdu na gong ltar dmigs pas phul bas 'thus/ de nas yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung gnod sbyin nor lha rnams kyang mchod yul du dmigs la sngar bzhin mchod lha spros te phul/ mthar mchod lha de rnams kyis rigs drug gi sems can bar do dang bcas pa dang*/ khyad par rang la gnod cing lan chags gdon bgegs rnams la yang sbyin pas/ de dag gis bdud rtsi mthong reg myang dri tshor ba tsam gyis sgrib gnyis byang tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sems rtog med chos kyi sku dang lus zag med rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur par bsam/ mchod lha rnams rang la thim/ thod pa bdud rtsi sgyed bu dang bcas pa 'ja' ltar yal nas 'dzin med kyi ngang du blo bzhag skabs 'dir khrid kyi dus yin na maṇ+ḍal me tog dang bcas bshams te/ tshom bu bdun pa gang mang*/ so bdun ma yang ci rigs su phul/ rgyun gyi nyams len skabs maṇ+ḍal dngos su bshams pa'am med kyang rung ste tshom bu bdun ma ci rigs 'bul lo// 'di la khrid yig 'ga' zhig tu bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos su bsgom pa ni thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang dmar po rdor dril 'dzin pa ni bde mchog sogs dang thun mong ba yin par bshad/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i khrid yig tu/ gnyis bral 'chad dus zhal shes gsum// zhes gsungs pa/ rtsa dbu ma'i khrid la dgongs pas ro rkyang gnyis bral gyi dbu mar ngos 'dzin par 'dug kyang*/ maṇ+ḍal 'chad dus zhes pa bde bar snang zhing*/ mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i khrig yig tu yang de ltar bshad do// zhal shes gnyis pa dbang bzhi blang ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ rtsa ba'i bla mas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la dbang bzhi bskur mi bskur gyi gnang ba zhu ba'i tshul gyis spyan 'khor ro ro gzigs pas/

brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis de ltar gyis shig ces gnang ba sbyin pa'i tshul gyis spyan cher gzigs nas bla ma brgyud pa de rnams g.yon skor gyis gcig la gcig thim nas mthar rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros rang gi dpral bar thim pas bum dbang thob/ lus sgrib dag lam bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ mgrin pa'i aḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim pas gsang dbang thob/ ngag sgrib dag lam tsaṇ+ḍā li bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ rang gi snying khar thim pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag pho nya'i lam sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ bla ma'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam la sems 'dzin med du ci gnas bzhag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ zhes brjod cing gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas/ zhal shes gsum pa bla ma bstim pa ni/ gzhal yas khang 'od du zhu gdan seng khri pad zla nyi gdan la thim/ de bla ma'i sku la thim/ bla ma de nyid dbu'i gtsug tor nas mar 'od du zhu/ gdan seng khri nas mas yar 'od du zhu ba thugs kha'i thad du 'od dmar ser li khri'i mdog can snum la dril ba bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur pa de nyid bde khril le byung nas rang gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs nas snying kha'i bam̐ yig la thim pas de nyid je cher song nas mthar 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pas bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres pa'i ngang la rang sems ji tsam gnas kyi bar bzhag

de yang gshis skye med stong nyid du rjen ne/ mdangs 'gag med mos gus su lam me ba'i ngang du bzhag de yang maṇ+ḍal dang phyi nang gsang mchod sogs bsod nams kyi tshogs dang bla ma rang la thim nas mnyam bzhag byed pa ye shes kyi tshogs gsog go /skyabs 'gro dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sbyang gzhi/ skye ba snga ma rigs drug tu skyes nas chags sdang gti mug gis las ngan bsags pa sbyong byed skyabs 'gro dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshogs gsog dang bcas nyams su blangs pas sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mngon du byed pa yin no// drug pa bdag lhar bskyed pa la sbyang gzhi rgya che ba dang zab pa mthar thug gsum las 'dir mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi ni/ rang sems lhan skyes ye shes brjod bral 'di nyid rkyen bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs su tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i rkyen gyis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bskyed pa ste/ de yang gsang ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ni rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug 'di'i rten 'brel las/ lte ba'i rtsa mdud gru gsum ma las thob pa'i khams dmar pos gang ba a shad kyi rnam pa'am/ 'di'i bam̐ yig gi rnam par bzhugs pa de nang gi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin/ de la brten nas phyi rol 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rnal 'byor ma/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi yul nyer bzhi dang gnas so gnyis na rang bzhin gyis bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku/ der ma zad 'dzam bu'i gling gi yul thams cad du gnas pa'i bud med rnams ni las las skyes pa/ ma mkha' 'gro'i rigs kyi bu mo ni rigs las skyes pa dang*/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar sgom pa ni sngags skyes yin la/ de ltar bla mas ngo sprod pa la nges shes skyes/ de'i rgyun skyong bar byed pa bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blangs/

phyi rol gyi rnal 'byor ma sprul pa'i sku thams cad dbang du 'du zhing*/ de la brten nas lhan skyes kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor mas byin gyis brlabs pas lhan skyes kyi rtags pa 'char bas na byin gyis yas brlabs rtog pa mas 'char zhes bya ba yin no// de yang rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim gyi sbyang gzhi'i gtso bo skye 'chi bar do gsum sbyong ba yin pas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi rjes su snang ba thams cad 'od gsal du thim pa'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa ni 'chi ba sbyong ba/ de las chos 'byung zla ba bam̐ yig sngags phreng rnams las 'od zer spro bsdus 'od kyi gong bur bsgom pa ni 'chi ba 'od gsal bar dor langs pa sbyong*/ de la zhal phyag gi rnam par gsal 'debs pa ni/ skye ba sbyong ba 'di lta bu'i rnam pas lam du byed pa'o// de ltar rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i zab khyad bdag gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang sgyur gnyis las dang por bdag gi gzhi sbyang ba ni/ ngag 'don las/ rang gi snying gar e e las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zhes pa nas/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ zhes pa'i bar ni bdag gi gzhi sbyang ba/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar ni bdag gi gzhi bsgyur ba/ ngag 'don du go cha bskyed pa de'i 'phros su yod kyang*/ rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi go rim ltar thog mar bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang ba ni/ ngag 'don las/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros te/ zhes pa nas/ bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs zhes pa'i bar ni gzhi sbyang ba/ de thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ zhes pa ni gzhan gyi gzhi bsgyur ba'o// brgyad pa dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug gi don yin te/

skabs 'dir ye shes pa spyan drangs shing bstim pa ni/ ngag 'don las/ phaiṃ rang gi snying kha'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas 'og min nas/ zhes pa nas/ yo ga shud+dho3haṃ zhes pa'i bar te ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i phyag rgya phaiṃ gyi sgra dang bcas te spyan drangs te/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ'i sngags rgya dang dmigs pas bstim zhing*/ 'khyud rgya dang yo ga shud+dho'i sngags rnams brjod/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang 'gro ba thams cad rnal 'byor mar gyur pa sngags skyes dang*/ yul nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams zhing skyes/ 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes gsum/ sngags rgyas gcig tu bsres pas pho nya gsum bsres bya ba yin no// tshar chen rin po che'i lus dkyil yig chung yid bzhin nor bu las/ 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor yan nyams su blangs pa'i mtshams su zhes skabs 'dir lus dkyil bsgom par gsungs pa gab pa'i rnam pa yin pas/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rtse'i khrid yig las/ de ltar ye shes pa bcug pas rkyen byas te lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal 'debs pa yin zhes gsungs pas/ skabs 'dir lus dkyil bsgom dgos la/ de la yang yig chung yid bzhin nor bu rtsa ba lta bu dang*/ bla ma gzhan dag gi yang yig cha sogs rnam grangs mang por 'khrugs sdebs gab sbas kyi rnam par yod pas dbang rtul rnams the tshom du 'gyur bas 'dir gab sbas med par bshad pa ni/ rang gi snying gar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs phyogs la zur bstan gyi nang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi bam̐ yig 'od du zhu ba las yi ge de'i srog gi a thung*/ de'i phyogs bzhir g.yon du ya ljang gu/ rgyab tu ra dmar po/ g.yas su la ser po/ mdun du wa dkar po de lnga'i mtha' skor du mdun nas brtsams te oṃ gsum ma'i sngags phreng dmar po g.yon skor du 'khod pa yongs su gyur pa las dbus su rnal 'byor ma dmar mo/

mdun du dkar mo/ g.yon du ljang gu/ rgyab tu dmar mo/ g.yas su ser mo/ mtha' skor gyi yig 'bru so gnyis rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa gnyis/ de thams cad rgyan cha lugs phyag mtshan dang bcas mngon rtogs ltar gsal 'debs pa ni lus dkyil yin la/ 'di rnams kyi bskyed gzhi'i yig 'bru rnams go sla yang*/ phyogs bzhi'i yig 'bru mdun gyi rnal 'byor ma dkar mos 'khrul gzhi byas pa'i mdun du ya/ g.yon du ra/ rgyab tu la/ g.yas su war byed pa ni 'khrul pa ste rgyu mtshan g.yon gyis ya rlung gi rang bzhin ljang gu rgyab kyi ra me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ g.yas kyi la sa'i rang bzhin ser po/ mdun gyi wa chu'i rang bzhin dkar po yin pas yig 'bru bsgom pa'i tshe thog mar g.yon nas brtsams dgos shing*/ 'ga' zhig gis yig 'bru bzhi po ha ri ni sar byed pa yang ma nges pa'o// yig 'bru de rnams kyi dag pa ni rdo rje lus la yul chen po so bdun gyi rtsa khams yi ge tshang bar gnas pas/ oṃ gsum ma yig 'bru so gnyis la dbus kyi bam̐ dang phyogs bzhi'i ya ra la wa rnams bsdoms pas yig 'bru so bdun la tshang bas zab gnad bla na med pa'o// 'di la yi ge mi 'dra ba mang du yod kyang*/ 'dir snyan brgyud lhug pa 'khrul med du gab sbas med par bkod pa yin pas yi ge 'dra min gzhan dang 'khrul bar mi bya zhing shin tu gces par zung zhig de ltar lus dkyil bsgom ma thag slob bshad kyi dgongs pa shing gnyis gzer gcig gis bsdoms pa'i dpes yi dam 'bral med du 'ching ba'i don gyis go cha bkod pa ni ngag 'don las/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo zhes pa nas/ phaṭa phaṭa dud ka tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ zhes pa'i bar ltar go cha bcing ngo*// ngag 'don du go cha bkod pa sngon du yod gab dkrugs yin pas lus dkyil gyi rjes su byed pa 'di'i slob bshad kyi zab gnad do// 'di yan chad kyi mngon rtogs sogs khrid yig tu gsal bas 'dir bri ma dgos pas bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa bskyed rim kyi bya ba zhes bya la/

gnyis pa gcad don nyams su len pa sems 'dzin gyi bya ba ni/ khrid kyi dus gsal snang thon par bsgoms pas rgyun gyi nyams len gyi thog tu phan par 'gyur zhing rtag par sems 'dzin bya mi dgos so// de yang gsal la drag la yun thung ba// bskyed pa'i rim pa gnad du che// zhes bshad pas nyog nyog mun rmugs bying thibs za zi'i rtog pa 'og 'gyu rgya 'byams su mi gtong bar gsal la myur ba gnad du che'o// dgu pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ ngag bzlas dang*/ yid bzlas gnyis las/ dang po ngag bzlas ni/ ngag 'don las/ rang gi snying gar chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyi bar yin la/ de yang lus dkyil bsgom pa'i dbang du byas te/ lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i thugs kar chos 'byung zla ba sa bon sngags phreng sogs bsgom pa las spro bsdu bya dgos pas thun mong ba ngag 'don dang thun mong ma yin pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i khrid yig tu gsal ba ltar ro// gnyis pa yid bzlas ni/ lus gnad drang por bsrangs te rlung ro gsum bsal/ 'og rlung phyed 'then tsam byas te rlung dal bar rngubs te rdzogs pa dang*/ mchil ma mnyam du lte 'og tu ldigs kyis bskyur bas lus dkyil yod med gang yin gyi snying ga'i chos 'byung sngags phreng bam̐ yig sogs lte bar khrig khrig gis sleb par bsam la slar 'og rlung rdzogs par 'then nas 'og rlung kha sbyor gyi bum chen 'dzin pa lam 'di'i khyad chos yin te/ sangs rgyas lam ni kha sbyor dag la gnas// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de yang chos 'byung sngags phreng sogs bde ba skye bar 'dod na gsang gnas dang*/ mi rtog pa bskyed par 'dod na lte bar 'bebs par gsungs kyang*/ gtso bor lte bar 'bebs pa 'di phyag len du yod/ de lta bu'i sngags phreng rnams klog pa'i tshul gyis yid bzlas rlung ji tsam thub kyi bar du bya/

mi thub pa dang dal bus rang 'gros su nar gyis btang ngo*// gtso bor ngag bzlas kho nas 'bad par gsungs so// zhar byung rdzogs rim ni/ rgyas bshad kyi dbang du byas na/ 'og rlung gi 'khor lo la brten nas bde ba bsgrub pa/ bar sngags kyi 'khor lo la brten nas drod bsgrub pa/ steng mkha' spyod kyi 'khor lo la brten nas mi rtog pa bsgrub pa/ gsang ba zung 'jug gi 'khor lo la brten nas bde stong sgrub pa sogs 'jug gnas ldang ba'i rim pa rgyas par gsungs kyang don 'dir 'dus pas slar yang rlung kha sbyor sngar bzhin bzung la/ chos 'byung bsnol ma'i mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' 'khyil dmar po g.yon 'khor du 'khor ba la sems gtad de 'dzin med du 'jog pa dang*/ yang rlung 'dzin pa'am ma bzung yang rung ste/ dbu ma gcig po gsal btab pa'i mar snar dga' 'khyil dmar po dang*/ yas sna'i smin mtshams su dga' 'khyil dkar po bsam la/ dga' 'khyil gnyis po dbu ma'i nang du yas mas nas 'khor ba mthar 'dres pa la sems bzung ste brjod med du 'jog pa sogs khrid yig ltar ro// bar 'dir chos nyid dngos ston gyi byin rlabs dang*/ rtsa dbu'i zab khrid thun mong ma yin pa thebs na 'dir bsgom dgos te/ brgyud 'debs las/ lte ba'i pad+mor rlung lda'i ti la dkar// zhes sogs kyi don yin pa'i phyir/ brgyud 'debs las/ tha mal 'od kyi gtum mo mdzes ldan ma// sogs kyi don ni/ dbu ma rlung sems bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor ram/ dbu ma kha dbye ba zhes don gcig ming gi rnam grangs su bshad pa ji ltar bsgom tshul ni/ ro rkyang dbu gsum dang dbu ma'i nang gi lte ba'i thad du ram̐ yig las me 'bar ba dang*/ dwangs ma zhu ba sogs khrid yig ltar ro// de'i rjes su rlung lus la gnas pa bde ba sgrub pa dang*/ sems la zhugs pa stong pa sgrub pa gnyis kyang khrid yig tu gsal ba ltar ro// 'di la gong gi rgyas bshad kyi sa bcad/

'og rlung gi 'khor lo brten nas bde ba bsgrub pa sogs rnam grangs bzhi ka 'dus shing tshang ngo*// bcu pa bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor ni/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ thun mong ba ni ngag 'don las/ snying kha'i bam̐ yig sngags dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum thams cad khyab/ ces pa nas/ de je phra je phra las mi dmigs par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar khrid yig ltar yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa ni gser chos kho na nges pa can du mdzad pas/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis/ mi dbang rdo rje rin chen dpal bzang gis bskul ngor mdzad pa kho na bzhin la/ de yang thun mjug rnams su bsam mi khyab thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gang rigs bsgom pa las gnyis ka bsgom mi dgos so// de nas rang nyid rje btsun ma'i skur gyur/ zhes thun mtshams kyi lhar langs te/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs sh+lau ka gnyis dang*/ mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam bya'o// de yang sbyang gzhi dus gsum du 'chi ba'i snang ba bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor 'dis sbyangs pas sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas chos sku dngos yin snyam pa'i rgyas btab pas 'bras bu de kho na nyid mngon du 'gyur ba yin gsungs/ bcu gcig pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la dngos dang*/ yan lag gnyis las/ dang po dngos ni/ de ltar rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor las langs te thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug pa'i tshe/ stong nyid kyi ngang las chu las chu bur rdol ba ltar rang nyid snang stong gnyis med kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan dang phyag mtshan med pa zhig gi skur langs te chags sdang gi yul gzugs mthong tshad rnal 'byor ma'i skur blta zhing*/ snyan dang mi snyan gyi sgra thams cad grags stong rnal 'byor ma'i gsung sngags kyi sgra dang*/ dran rtogs gang shar thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs bde stong dbyer med du shes par byas la ma yengs par bskyong ba 'di gal che bas dran 'dzin drag pos ma yengs par bya ba gnad du che bar gsungs/

gnyis pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la phyi rol mchod pa/ tshogs 'khor/ sbyin sreg tshes bcu/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor te lnga las/ de rnams khrid yig dang rnam bshad sogs yi ge zur du yod pa ltar dang*/ khyad par gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni ngag 'don ltar ro// phyi rol mchod pa ni kha zas kyi rnal 'byor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyis byed tshul dang*/ de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig la dbang bzhi'i lam tshang tshul sogs khrid yig ltar go ba gces so// de bzhin nyams su blangs pas dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum gyi grol tshul gong du spyi don gnyis pa bshad pa ltar yin pa/ ches myur ba 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ni rje btsun yab yum zhal sbyor dang*/ yum rkyang gi 'pho ba gnyis su gsungs kyang*/ bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa ni 'pho ba'i mchog yin pas de nyid la/ nan tan du bgyis na nges par mkha' spyod kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro// rdzogs rim dngos gzhi chos nyid brgyud nas ston pa dpe gsum gyi sgo nas ston par byed pa ni khrid yig tu rgyas par bshad pa ltar ro// spyir bskyed rim gyis skye ba sbyong*/ bsam mi khyab kyi nyer bsdus 'chi ba sbyong*/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor rnams kyis bar do sbyong bar byed pa yin/ de yang bskyed rim gsal ba'i ngo bo stong pa'i rang mdangs bskyed rim du gsal zhing*/ 'char ba de gnyis kyi ngo bo dbyer med brjod bral gyi ngang du 'jog pa gnad che'o// mdor na bskyed rim bzlas pa dang bcas pa ni mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo yin la/ rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma ni phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs kyi myur lam khyad par 'phags pa yin pas zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa la 'bad par bya'o gsungs/ zab lam 'di lta bu'i mkha' spyod du bgrod nas mkha' spyod ces bya ba rdzu 'phrul gyi nam mkha' la rgyu zhing spyod yul du byed pa lus mdzes shing lo bcu drug pa'i na tshod dang cha lugs can/

tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa ci bsam pa'i longs spyod nam mkha' las 'byung ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro zhing sprul sku las chos nyan pa/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams dang skal pa mnyam par spyod cing rten de nyid las 'tshang rgya bar nges pa sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob nges pa de ltar ro// de yang phyi rol na rnal 'byor ma yod pa'i gnyis 'dzin med par rang sems rnal 'byor ma skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba stong gsal brjod med gnyug ma zung 'jug blo 'das 'di'i rang ngo shes pa gal che ste/ brgyud 'debs las/ skyes 'gag gnas gsum bral ba gdod ma'i gshis// zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis don yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar rang ngo shes pas rtsa yig thig le rlung sems dang bcas pa bde chen chos kyi sku thob nas gzugs sku'i sprul pa grangs med pas sems can mtha' klas pa'i 'gro don byed pa'i phyir/ rtsa rlung thig le e wam̐ dbyings su thim// zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gi don bstan pa yin no// de ltar nā ro mkha' spyod kyi zab gnad snying por bsdus pa mthong ba rab gsal zhes bya ba 'di ni dad pa'i nor can khyim pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa sde pa klu dbang lags kyis nan tur chen pos yang yang bskul ba la brten nas dge slong bya bral ba pad+ma 'phrin las kyi rang lo don gnyis su slebs pa'i steng du bris pa'i yi ge ba ni nyer gnas dge slong phan bdes bgyis pa yin la/ spyir lugs 'dir rgya bod kyi yi ge mang zhing*/ de dag kyang 'dra min sna tshogs su snang yang*/ 'dir tshar chen rdo rje 'chang yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i gsung kho na gtso bor bzung ba bla ma'i man ngag snyan brgyud lhug par bkod pa yin la/ mtha' dpyod kyi bshad pa sogs khrid yig rnams su gsal bas 'dir ma bkod cing*/

thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal shes gsum ldan gyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ lus dkyil sogs gab sbas med par dkyus su bkod pa la bla ma lha dang chos bdag srung mar bcas pas bzod par bzhes te/ bdag gzhan thams cad mkha' spyod bde ba chen po'i lam du drang du gsol/ sa skya'i zab chos snyan brgyud snying po mchog /zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor mkha' spyod ma'i// nyams len snying por bsdus pa 'di bkod pa'i// dge des bdag gzhan mkha' spyod bgrod par shog /ka l+yā naṃ war+dhan+tu// ༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bsnyen yig bsdus pa dngos grub mchog ster bzhugs so// ༈ /mkha' spyod dbang mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// rigs kyi bdag po bla ma rdo rje chos// gnas gsum mkha' 'gror bcas la gus btud nas// nā ro mkha' spyod bsnyen thabs mdo tsam bri// de la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs dang nyams khrid zhal shes thun mong ma yin pa rnams legs par thob nas/ bsnyen pa byed na rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi sgo nas nyams su len tshul mtha' dpyod sogs mang du dgos pas btang snyoms su bzhag ste/ byin rlabs dang mngon rtogs kyi lung thob pa tsam gyis bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ gnas khang rang dbang can du gza' skar bzang zhing khyad par yar mar gyi tshes bcu gang rigs la mtshams su zhugs te/ mkha' spyod ma'i bris 'bur gyi rten dgram pa'am med kyang rung ste/ cog rtse'i khar sha chang gi sbags pa'i 'das gtor gcig dang*/ spro na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang gtor 'bul gang byed kyi chos skyong gi gtor ma sogs bshams pa'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bshams/ rang gi stan 'og tu sa dkar gyis rdo rje rgya gram g.yung drung g.yon skor du bris/ mdun du nang mchod la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa rdor dril sogs bshams/ mtshams la 'jug khar cha gsum tshar gcig btang rjes gu gul gyis gnas khang bdug shing sgo phyir mtshams thos bcad/

de nas stan la 'dug ste dgong thun nas mgo btsugs pa'i thog mar skyabs yul bla ma rdo rje chos kho na gsal btab nas/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs kyis skyabs 'gro brgya tsam gyi mthar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la zhes sogs kyi skyabs gsol gcig byas la skyabs yul rang la bstim/ bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ zhes sogs kyis sems bskyed lan gsum bya/ skabs der kyai rdor dang brag rdzong ma ltar rdor sems bsgom bzlas dang yig brgya brgya tsam bzlas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sogs nas/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur gyi bar brjod/ skabs der sa gzhi spos byugs kyi maṇ+ḍal gang mang 'bul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa lan nyer gcig tsam brjod/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi snying khar e e las chos 'byung gru gsum zhes sogs nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar gyis bdag bskyed legs par gsal btab/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zhes sogs nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo zhes pa'i bar gyi go cha bkod/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros te zhes sogs nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur zhes pa'i bar gyis 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ phaiṃ zhes sogs 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar g.yon skor lan gsum dang*/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas zhes sogs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes ye shes pa dgug bstim bya/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha zhes sogs lan gsum pad skor dang 'khyud rgya lan gsum bya/ bzlas pa la gnyis kyi ngag bzlas gtso che bas rang gi snying khar chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs zhes pa nas/

rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur gyi bar brjod nas thod phreng ngam bo dhi tse'i phreng ba gang rung lag gnyis thal sbyar gyi bar du bzung*/ oṃ pā de pā de ma hā dz+nyā na sarba bud+dha ma yaṃ bha be te hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥhoḥhoḥ.ā khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa bdun nam gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa lag g.yon pas 'dren cing*/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki ni ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes sogs ci nus bzlas mthar nyams khrid thob cing rlung 'dzin shes na/ snying ga'i chos 'byung lte bar phab ste bum can bzung zhing yid bzlas bya/ de ltar yin na dmigs pa gsal 'debs byas la yid bzlas sa bcad ma stong tsam zhig byed/ thun bsdu khar bsam mi khyab thun mong ba ni/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ zhes sogs nas mi dmigs par gyur gyi bar brjod/ de yi ngang las rang nyid rje btsun ma'i skur gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag ces sogs sh+lau ka gnyis dang*/ na maḥbadz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa li ye/ mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bde stong zlos gar ni// zhes sogs mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam yang spro na bya/ bsdu na ma byung yang 'thus/ thun mtshams su gtor ma nang mchod dang*/ chu dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i chang gis bran te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas stong pa'i ngang las thod pa chen po/ zhes sogs nas/ badz+ra mu'i bar gzhung ltar bya/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor spro na dkyus bzhin dang*/ gtor 'bul gzhan dgos kyang bya'o// de rjes srod thun la yang skyabs 'gro/ rdor sems bzlas pa sogs nyung tsam ma gtogs gong bzhin bya/ sang zhog thor thun nyi shar nas gung gi bar zhog thun/ phyed yol nas nyi nub bar dgong thun/ mun rub nas ci rigs par srod thun/ bzhi ga la byed lugs gong dang 'dra/

bdun phrag gcig tsam gyi bar skyabs 'gro dang rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ maṇ+ḍal gsol 'debs sogs ci mang dang bzlas thun nyung tsam pa/ de rjes skyabs 'gro dang yig brgya nyer gcig tsam la bsdus/ maṇ+ḍal lan gcig gsol 'debs lan gsum bya/ gzhan bzlas pa dngos gzhir 'bad/ de ltar bzlas pa spro na 'bru 'bum ste 'bum phrag so lnga'am gzhan du 'bum phrag bzhi mdzad pa phyag len du yod/ bzlas pa'i grangs song nas sbyin sreg byed na yig cha mang du yod cing lag len dka' bas mar me'i sbyin sreg tsam gyis 'thus/ bzlas dmigs dngos gzhi dkyus ltar la/ bzlas pa'i dus sems can thams cad dang rang gi lus kyi srin bu tshun chad rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i sngags di ri ri 'dren par bsam pa ma gtogs spro bsdu mang po mi dgos shing*/ nyams khrid thob nas yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu gang rigs la sgrub mchod bdag 'jug sogs byas na legs shing rgyun ldan 'di tsam gyis 'thus par sems so// nā ro mkha' spyod bsnyen yig chung ngu 'di// 'khrul zad gong ma'i dgongs pa ji bzhin du// dge slong bya bral pad+ma phrin las kyis// bris dges 'gro rnams mkha' spyod 'grub par shog/ ༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod kyi tshogs mchod tshogs gnyis myur 'grub bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma mchog dang rnal 'byor ma// gnyis med zhabs la gus btud nas// rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i// tshogs mchod cho ga 'dir bshad bya// 'dir nā ro mkha' spyod kyi tshogs mchod bya ba la/ sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying pos sngon 'gror gnas dus rten bshams pa mchod rdzas te bzhi dang*/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga rjes sogs bshad pa ltar dang po gnas ni gnas khang phyag bdar bya zhing chags chags gdab/ maṇ+ḍal me tog rten dgram pa sogs dang*/ gnyis pa dus ni/ tshogs bsog par 'dod na yar ngo'i tshes bcu/ sgrib pa dag par 'dod na mar ngo'i tshes bcur bya bar gsungs/

gsum pa rten ni/ spro na bdag 'jug skabs ltar dkyil 'khor gsum po bshams pa'am yang na sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor chos 'byung sngags phreng sogs phyag len ltar dang*/ bsdu na me long chang gis bris pa'i dbus su me tog dmar po'i tshom bu gcig bkod pa stegs la bshams/ bzhi pa mchod rdzas ni/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me gsum rten gyi g.yon du bsham/ dri chab/ gtor ma/ zhal zas gsum g.yas su bsham/ ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba mdun du bsham mo// tshogs kyi yo byad ni ci 'byor bsham mo// gzhan 'di bzhin gtor ma gsum dgos so// dngos gzhi'i cho ga la/ maṇ+ḍal zhu 'bul sogs byed par gsungs pa tshogs pa yod na zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad bde kye nas gsungs pa ltar yin kyang rang gcig po nyams su len par spros pa mi dgos/ cho ga gzhan rnams sa chen gyis tho tsam las ma gsungs pas/ 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung ltar don bsdus te brjod na mdo rgyas mtshams pas 'di ltar/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dmar gtor chab kyis bran la lha'i nga rgyal gyis/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa nas/ ga ga na khaṃ ghṛ ṇa daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngos/ bgegs dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i las rtsom pa la bar du gcod pa ma byed par gzhan du dengs shig ces dang*/ sum+bha brjod cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bskrad/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub skyed pa'i se gol shar nas phyogs bzhi g.yon skor dang*/ mtshams bzhi g.yas skor du gdab cing zhal bzhi pa'i sum+bha rkang pa re re brjod pa ste tshar gnyis kyis bgegs bskrad/ mdun gyi nang mchod mngon rtogs ltar byin rlabs byas te lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsir g.yon skor du chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bri zhing*/

oṃ gsum ma'i sngags brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs/ bdud rtsi des lag pa g.yas g.yon phan tshun du gtor zhing mnye tshul bya/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis rang gi dpral mgrin snying ga gsum du thig le re bkod nas rang lus dag par byas/ gnas khang phyi mchod rnams la gtor bas lha rdzas las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du mchod pa rgya chen po dwangs shing thogs pa med par dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pa ni spyir gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab pa yin no// skabs 'dir skyabs sems dang khyad par rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas nan du byas la/ sdig sgrib sbyangs nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor nas bzung sgrub thabs ltar mngon rtogs rgyas pa sogs dkyus bzhin bsam mi khyab kyi bar byas te thun mtshams kyi lhar langs nas mchod rdzas rnams la nang mchod kyis bdud rtsi gtor zhing sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs te stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon zhes sogs nas rgyas par gyur cig gi bar dang*/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa sgrub mchod ltar ro// de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gsum bkod pa ni sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor ram/ me long tshom bu dang bcas pa gang yin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun bskyed kyi rim pa sgrub mchod bdag 'jug gi yi ge ltar lhar bskyed nas bzung bstod pa'i bar bya'o// skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul bar gsungs pa/ dang po sgrub thabs ltar rnal 'byor ma la 'bul/ gnyis pa chos skyong ni gur zhal gtso bor byed pa sa skya pa rang lugs yin/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis 'bul lo// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad thams cad sgrub thabs kyi gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas tshogs phud tshang ba snod gcig tu bshams pa bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la 'bul te/

zhal zas ro brgya ldan zhing yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni bla ma lhar bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /oṃ gu ru badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ gtor ma rnams la bran cing*/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ yi dam chos skyong gzhan yod kyang so so'i sngags mthar a ka ro btags pas phul/ tshogs chang gi phud kyang snod du blugs te bla ma dang lha tshogs rnams la 'bul zhing*/ dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bsal nas// rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba'i// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /ces brjod pa phul/ gzhan yang bdag 'jug gi mdun bskyed la nang mchod 'bul skabs ltar bla ma yi dam chos skyong sogs la tshogs chang gi nang mchod mtheb srin gyis 'thor nas 'bul lo// tshogs pa yod na las kyi slob mas phyag sngon du 'gro bas rnam lnga 'dod skor gyi phyag rgya dang bcas te sha chang sogs tshogs rdzas gzung ste/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'du ba rnams la the tshom med// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa phag /rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du dgongs// zhes brjod cing rim pa bzhin du drangs/ len pa pos kyang pad skor bya zhing*/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba// de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal// zhes brjod cing blangs gnyis char gyis a ho mahā su kha hoḥ zhes brjod par bya'o// skabs 'dir 'phags pa rin po ches lag mchod byed par gsungs pa bde mchog ltar dgos pa ha cang rgyas grags pas 'dir 'phags pa'i gsung bde mchog nag po lugs kyi mchod phreng las btus pa ni lag pa g.yon pa la bdud rtsi gtor zhing*/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing mnyes nas lag mthil du sor mo lnga bsdus pa'i dbus dang sen mo lnga la me tog gi thig le re bkod pa zla ba'i gdan drug tu bsam/ mthe bong oṃ haḥdakar po/ mdzub mor na ma hiḥser po/ gung mo la swā hā hu dmar po/ srin lag la bau ṣaṭa he nag po/ mthe'u chung la hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser/ sen mo lnga'i dbus su phaṭa haṃ ljang gu/ lag mthil du tshom bu lnga bkod pa zla gdan du bsam pa'i lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo/ mdun nas brtsams te g.yon skor gyis rim bzhin ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo/ hriṃ moṃ dkar mo/ hriṃ hriṃ ser mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu/ phaṭa phaṭa dud ka rnams dpa' bo dang dpa' mo lha'i rnam par bsgom dgos kyang gsal ma theb na/ yig 'bru'i rnam par bsgoms pas don lha'i rang bzhin yin no// lag pa'i sa chu me rlung nam mkha' khams lnga ltung byed/ gsod byed/ 'gugs byed/ pad+ma gar dbang ma/ pad+ma'i drwa ba can ma ste/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma lngar shes par bya/ de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gzugs brnyan lag pa'i rgyab tu shar bar blta ba'am mdun bskyed dang ma 'brel na lag par me tog gi thig le bkod pa rdo rje rnal 'byor mar mos la/ phaiṃ zhes pho nya gsum dbyer mi phyed par gyur par bsam/ oṃ gsum ma dang dpa' bo dpa' mo'i go cha'i sngags rnams gong ltar brjod/ puṣ+pe sogs rnam lngas mchod cing tshogs rdzas nas cung zad re lag mthil du bzhag nas mchod pas mnyes par bsam/ de nas lag pa g.yon pa la bdud rtsi gtor zhing*/ lag pa gnyis phan tshun mnyes pas lha rnams snyoms par zhugs par bsam la/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis rang gi dpral mgrin snying gar reg cing mthar lus thams cad la byugs pas lha thams cad lus la thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod do// lag mchod 'di bde mchog gi dgongs don yin la bsdu na gong du bshad pa'i bdud rtsis lag g.yas g.yon phan tshun du gtor mnye byed pa gnas gsum du thig le byed pa des kyang go chod par snang*/

de nas lag g.yon pa'i kun spyod kyis khrid yig tu bshad pa ltar kha zas kyi rnal 'byor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang yang rung ba'i rnal 'byor gsal btab la/ nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul gyis zhen med du tshim par longs spyod par bya'o// g.yeng bar mi 'gyur ba'i glu gar dang rol mo'i sgra sogs phyi nang gi lha mchod pa'i bsam pas bya zhing*/ dus kun bdag dang snang ba thams cad rje btsan ma'i sku dang*/ sgra thams cad grags stong rnal 'byor ma'i sngags dang*/ bsam pa thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du dmigs la/ phyi nang gi nyams myong bde ba thams cad kyis rnal 'byor mar mchod par bsam zhing yang lha'i rnam par gsal 'debs dgos par gsungs/ de nas lhag ma bsdus pa la 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i nang nas chang gi kha phru btab la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha liṃ bhak+ṣa si swā hā/ lan gsum gyis byin/ kol+la e ri sogs kyi rdo rje'i glu blangs la/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las 'byung 'gyur zhing*// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i pad+ma la ni rol mdzad pa// bkra shis des ni bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /mdun bskyed kyi lha la bdag gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang dam tshig gi nyes pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ 'chi ba'i tshe mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su khrid pa dang*/ mthar thug bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pa'i// bden pa des ni lha mo 'di dag rnams// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/ces pa'i bden stobs lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa// des ni sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces pa'i smon lam btab/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod gsol bya/ mdun bskyed bris 'bur gyi rten yod na/ 'dir ni gzugs dang zhes sogs dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhas brtan bzhugs bya/ dkyil 'khor dang sin+dhū ra sogs kyi rten yod na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs dang*/ badz+ra mus ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ gtor ma gsum rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bskyal/ rang gi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsrung*/ go cha'i sngags brjod cing rgyas btab la nyal ba'i spyod lam rnal 'byor chos bzhin du bya'o// phan yon ni 'phags pa rin po ches/ de ltar rgyun du rnal 'byor du byed pa ni sdig pa dang dam tshig gi nyes pa 'dags pa dang*/ lha dang bla ma'i thugs dam skong bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs myur du rdzogs par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// 'di yang tshangs dbyangs rta mgrin gyis bskul ngor sa skya'i snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i dge slong bya bral ba pad+ma phrin las kyis rje btsun gong ma'i gsung gi dgongs don ltar rang gnas thub bstan kun bzang yang rtser sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong sman mchog gis bgyis pa'o// dge 'dis bdag gzhan 'gro ba rnams// sgrib byang tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs te// mkha' spyod dga' mas rjes bzung nas// bla med byang chub thob par shog/ ༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs 'dod gsol dang smon lam kyi 'grel ba snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i snying khu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hī ye/ bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin chen rdo rje 'chang*// mkha' spyod gtso mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dbyer med zhabs kyi pad+mor gus btud nas// rdo rje'i gsung gi don 'grel 'dir bshad bya// 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi zab chos rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod kyi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa pad dkar bzhad pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba/

tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i 'dod don gsol 'debs sh+lau ka bcu gcig gi don 'grel 'bri ba la/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni chos skor 'di'i lam gyi lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i bsdu don yin pas brjod bya nyung yang brjod don rgya che ba zhig go /de yang thog mar dal 'byor gru chen sh+lau ka dang pos thun mong gi sngon 'gro rnams bstan pa yin pas de la bzhi ste/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa sgom pa/ las dkar nag gi rgyu dang*/ de'i 'bras bu bsam pa bzhi las/ dang po la ngo bo dang*/ rgyu dang*/ dpe la sogs kyis rnyed dka' ba'i tshul dang*/ gnyis pa la spyir 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa dang*/ khyad par lus rten 'di nges par 'chi bas/ 'chi ba'i dus rkyen ma nges pa sogs sgo du ma bsam tshul/ shi nas las dkar nag 'bras bu so sor myong dgos pa'i phyir/ gsum pa las dkar nag lung ma bstan gsum bsam pa/ bzhi pa mi dge bas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal/ dkar pos mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi yon tan/ 'dres ma'am lung ma bstan dge bar bsgyur ba'i tshul rnams bshad pa la gzings kyi dpes 'chad pa ste/ dal 'byor bco brgyad tshang ba'i lus rten gyi gru chen 'di dal bar ma lus tshe mi rtag par dran pa nges 'byung gi blo yi ba dan dkar pos bskyod pa'i tshe mi dge ba'i las ngan mi 'dod pa'i rlung dang sbyar na phyir 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ldog pas dkar po dge ba'i las bzang gi 'bras bu rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor legs par spyod pa mthun pa'i rlung gis rab tu bskul nas 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las sgrol bar shog ces bshad pa'i phyir/ sh+lau+o ka gnyis pa bslu med skyabs gnas sogs kyi don ni thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro bshad pa yin pas de la yang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas dang*/

maṇ+ḍal dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang lnga'o// de la yang khrid gzhung du lam log pa mu stegs byed las khyad par du byas pa skyabs 'gro/ dman pa nyan rang las khyad par du bya ba sems bskyed/ sdig sgrib sbyang ba la yi ge brgya pa/ tshogs myur du rdzogs pa maṇ+ḍal/ byin rlabs myur du 'jug par bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang lngar gsungs pa'i rgyas bshad khrid yig tu gsal zhing*/ 'dir tshig bcad kyi don bkrol na/ bslu med skyabs gnas kun gcig tu bsdus pa rje btsun bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos gtsug gi nor bu ltar brten cing deng nas byang chub kyi bar skyabs su 'gro ba/ dngos brgyud kyi pha mar gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams byang chub tu 'god pa'i phyir smon 'jug gi bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pas kun nas bslangs te bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang brje ba'i sems bskyed dang tshad med bzhis 'gro don rgya chen po snying la yang dag par zhugs pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum spyi bor bsgoms pa'i sbyor mtshams byang sems kyi bdud rtsis rang rgyud la yod pa'i sdig sgrib nyes pa dang ltung ba'i dri ma bkrus shing sbyang ba dang*/ maṇ+ḍal ni bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang rjes su 'brel ba yin pas rje btsun bla ma gsung rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa la zhal shes pa rnam pa gsum dang 'brel ba'i maṇ+ḍal dang*/ ku sā la'i tshogs bsog pa dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos la gsol 'debs rtse gcig tu byas pa'i rjes su dbang bzhi blang zhing bstim pa'i mthu la rtag par thugs rjes 'dzin zhing skyong bar shog cig pa'i smon lam btab pa'o// sh+lau ka gsum pa yid 'ong rgyal yum sogs kyi don ni sbyang gzhi skye 'chi bar do gsum sbyong byed rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsam pa phyi dang*/ snying gar chos 'byung zla gdan la gnas pa'i bam̐ yig nang dang*/ rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug gsang ba'i mkha' spyod mar shes pa ni bdag gi gzhi sbyang zhing bsgyur ba ste/

de yang rgya che ba dang*/ zab pa dang*/ mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi gsum du yod pa las/ 'dir phyi ma mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi rang gi gzhi lus sbyong byed rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rjes chags gzhon nu bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can yid du 'ong ba rgyal ba'i yum mchog tu gsal ba phyi'i rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin du bsgyur ba dang*/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig nang gi rje btsun ma mchog gi rang bzhin dang*/ rang gi sems nyid stong gsal zung 'jug brjod bral gyi ngo bor shes pa gsang ba'i mkha' spyod rgyal ba'i yum gsum smin grol gyi zab lam la brten nas rang zhal mngon sum mthong ba'i nyams myong gi rtse dgas rtag tu rol par shog ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ sh+lau ka bzhi pa snod kyi 'jig rten sogs kyi don ni/ gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang bsgyur la dgongs pa yin pas/ ma dag pa snod kyi 'jig rten gyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed dag pa chos 'byung e dbyibs gzhal yas khang 'od kyi rang bzhin dmar mo gru gsum gyi rnam par bsgyur ba dang*/ sbyang gzhi nang bcud kyi sems can rigs drug gi sems can sbyong byed bam̐ yig las byung ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par bsgyur ba/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rang bzhin snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su 'char ba ste/ snod kyi 'jig rten e yig ste chos 'byung gru gsum gyi rnam pa'i gzhas yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi sems can bam̐ yig las byung ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin dang*/ de gnyis kyi byed po zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus cir snang dag pa'i snang bar rtag tu 'char bar shog ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ sh+lau ka lnga pa de ltar phyogs dang zhes sogs kyi don ni/ gang zag dbang po rab grol tshul bshad pa la/ sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying pos/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myang*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go

/ces gsungs pa ltar/ gang zag des rnal 'byor bcu gcig po'i nyams len chag med dang gzhi bsnyen mthar phyin pa bya zhing*/ zla re bzhin yar ngo mar ngo gnyis kyi tshes bcu sgrub mchod sogs chag med bgyis pa de/ 'chi khar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bud med tha mal pa'i rnam par byon pa la der ngo shes nas/ des rnal 'byor pa de'i lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du dngos su 'khrid par byed pa'o// de'i don tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa ni/ de ltar phyogs ni bcu dang zla ba ni gcig ste grangs kyi mngon brjod dper bkod pa'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi zab lam nyams len gyis/ nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus na mkha' spyod dga' ma mi'i bud med kyi rnam pa la kha dog byu ru ltar dmar ba'i mdog can li khri'i kha dog can gyi skra sil bu thur du grol ba dmar ser gyi smin ma dang ldan pa'i zur mig g.yo bas/ mngon sum du rnal 'byor pa de rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas mkha' spyod kyi grong du 'khrid par shog ces pa'o// sh+lau ka drug pa sin+dhu ra laṅka li sogs kyi don ni gang zag dbang po 'bring gi grol tshul bshad pa la gong ltar 'bad pas ma grol na/ gzhi bsnyen yi ge'i grangs te rnal 'byor ma so gnyis kyi grangs can oṃ gsum mar yig 'bru so gnyis yod pa la 'bru 'bum lan gnyis te 'bum phrag drug cu re bzhi tsam bzlas pa'i bsnyen pa song bas laṅka li ya'i shing zhes bya ba rgya bal rnams su 'byung yang bod du mi 'byor bas do rgod pa zhes lo mas dgos tshed yongs ba de'i nang sbugs stong du yod pa'i shing de'i sdong bu'i nang du sgrub mchod lan mang du byas pa'i sin+dhu ra blug rtsa bar g.yung drung gi spar brkos pa sgrub grogs bde mchog gi bsnyen song sba dbyug thogs pa dang bcas dur khrod du gzhung ltar sgrub pa'i sin+dha ra des rang gi dpral bar g.yung drung gi par btab nas rang gcig pu grogs med par phyogs kun tu 'khyams shing 'phong ra lta bu'i bud med mang du tshogs par lha'i nga rgyal gyis bltas pas bud med gang gi dpral bar rang gi smin mtshams gyi g.yung drung de me long du gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar 'phos nas/

bud med de rnam pa ji ltar snang yang the tshom med par de nyid rnal 'byor ma ngo shes par byas la phyag dang g.yon nas bskor ste gsol ba btab pas/ de rang gi lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste mkha' spyod du khyer ba yin la/ de la laṅka li'i sgrub pa bya tshul gyi yi ge zur du yod pa ltar shes dgos shing*/ don de bsdus pa'i tshogs su bcad pa ni/ sgrub mchod kyi maṇ+ḍal sin+dhu ra laṅka li yi shing ngam do rgod pa lta bur blug pa dang grogs 'khor bcas bde mchog gi gzhi bsnyen song ba dang bcas te ro ldan te dur khrod kyi gnas su sgrubs shing grub nas yul kun tu nyul bas/ rgyal rigs rje rigs bram ze dmangs rigs gdol pa sogs kyi bud med rgan gzhon rnam pa ma nges pa gang gi mdzod sbur rang gi dpral ba'i smin mtshams kyi g.yung drung 'khyil ris can de 'phos pa'i tshe the tshom med par gsol ba btab pas bud med de rnal 'byor ma shin tu mdzes mas rang gi lag pa'i 'khrig ma nas bzung ste dngos su mkha' spyod du 'khrid par shog ces pa'i don no// sh+lau la ka bdun pa nang gi 'phags mos zhes sogs kyi don ni/ gang zag dbang po tha ma'i grol tshul bshad pa la/ rnam pa gcig tu khrid yig ltar na rab 'bring gnyis kyi lam gyis grol bar ma nus na da dung sgyid lug med par nyams su blangs pas nam zhig 'chi ba 'od gsal chos skur ldang ba'i tshe rnal 'byor ma'i bzlas sgom gyi snang ba shar bas rkyen byas/ dus der rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas te sgrub pa po'i yid lus de seṅge'i khrir bzhag 'ja'i gur phub cing me tog gi char phab rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te mkha' spyod du skyel bar byed pas na/ 'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas su// rol mo sil snyan sgra snyan sogs mchod pa'i// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog

/ces gsungs pa yin/ 'on kyang 'di ni dbang po tha mar 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor bshad pa yin la/ de la yang rje btsun yab la brten pa'i yab yum zhal sbyor gyi 'pho ba dang*/ yum la brten pa'i yum rkyang gi 'pho ba gnyis las 'dir phyi ma yin/ de la 'jug gnas ldang ba gsum las gnas pa'i skabs/ rang nyid rje btsun mar gsal ba'i dbu ma'i mas snar nang gi rnal 'byor ma bam̐ yig dmar gsal bsam pa/ spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkhar bla ma mkha' spyod mar gsal ba la 'pho zhing 'di la yig cha zur du yod pas rgyas pa der blta'o// 'dir bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa ni/ nang gi phag mo rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bo bam̐ yig des gzung 'dzin gyi 'khri shing bcom pa'i phyir mchog gi rtsa dbu ma d+dhū tir zhugs pa'i gar mkhan ma lta bus spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga'i sgo nas sprin lam ste nam mkha'i dbyings su thon te yab yum zhal sbyor ltar na spyi bo'i khrag 'thung dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i rnam pas 'khyud cing snyoms 'jug gi bde bas rol ba dang 'dir bla ma'i sku la thim pas gnyis su med par shog cig pa'i don no// sh+lau ka brgyad pa lte ba'i pad+mo sogs kyi don ni/ 'di la spyir bskyed rim phag mo mkha' spyod dang*/ rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma gnyis/ phyi ma 'di la bde mchog rtsa rgyud le'u dang po las/ pho nya mchog 'bring tha ma rnams// zhes gsungs pa'i don pho nya rtsa mchog dbu ma/ 'bring yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rtsa/ tha ma ba spu bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi'i rtsa phran gzhan rnams yin pa las 'dir rtsa dbu ma/ de la yang chos nyid dngos su ston pa dang*/ rgyud nas ston pa gnyis las/ rgyud nas ston pa khrid yig gi dkyus su bshan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa/ shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa/ sgyu ma mkhan 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad la mkhas pa gsum gyi dpe dang sbyar te/ gzhi chos can 'khor ba'i gnad/ lam sgom pa'i gnad/

'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gnad gsum gyis ston te/ chos nyid dngos su ston pa la byin rlabs kyi yi ge zur du yod/ 'di la rtsa dbu ma'i khrid yig che ba rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa yi ge gsar rnying mang du yod/ chung ba shin tu zab pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsung yod pa shin tu gces/ 'di la rje btsun yab dang thun mong ba dang yum gyi thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ shin tu zab pa yab dang thun mong ma yin pa 'di yin par bzhed de/ 'on kyang 'di ni shin tu zab pa yin pas 'di bri bar ma 'os pas tshigs bcad don 'brel tsam zhig smos na/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus la rtsa gsum gsal btab pa'i lte ba'i pad+mor nam mkha' dang 'byung bzhi'i rlung lnga'i ngo bo ti la ka ste thig le lnga tshoms gsal btab cing*/ de la rtse gcig tu sems gtad de bsgoms pa'i rlung kha sbyor rnal 'byor gyi lus dang sems rtsa rnams la dri yi bzhon pa ste rlung zhugs pa yis bde ba chen po mchog gis bdag rgyud rab tu tshim par shog ces pa'o// sh+lau ka dgu pa tha mal 'od kyi gtum mo sogs kyi don ni khrid yig gi dkyus su gsal ba'i rtsa dbu ma'i rdzogs rim chos nyid rgyud nas ston pa'i sa bcad gsum gyi bar ma lam sgom pa'i gnad de la chags can dang chags bral gnyis kyi phyi ma la dbu mar rlung sems bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bsdus nas bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po rtsa dbu ma kha dbye ba'i rnal 'byor yin la/ de dag gi dmigs khrid rnams khrid yig tu gsal zhing tshigs su bcad pa'i 'bru gnon ni/ tha mal gyi rang lus rnal 'byor mar gsal ba de yang 'od kyi dmar gsal le zhig gi nang rtsa gsum gsal ba'i dbu ma'i nang gi lte bar tsaṇ+ḍa lī ste gtum mo 'od kyi rang bzhin shes rab kyi ngo bo'i dga' ma ram̐ yig dmar nag gi rnam par mdzes ldan yid du 'ong ma de nyid a wa dhū ti'i 'og sgo 'byed tshul rlung gi rnal 'byor dga' ma'i 'dzum dkar bzhad pa'i rol rtsed kyis dbu ma'i yas snar bde ba'i rang bzhin thabs kyi ngo bo ham̐ yig gzhon nu de nyid snyoms 'jug gi rol pas yongs su mnyes par byas nas/
