bdag rgyud la bde stong zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i dga' bzhi'i ye shes pa thob par shog ces so// sh+lau ka bcu pa skye 'gag gnas gsum sogs kyi don ni/ gong du smos pa ltar mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi rang sems lhan skyes kyi ye shes brjod bral 'di nyid bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs su tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i rkyen gyis bskyed rim phag mo mkha' spyod rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa yin la/ de yang gsang ba'i rnal 'byor ma rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug brjod bral 'di nyid kyi rten 'brel las/ lte ba'i rtsa mdud gru gsum gyi dbus su dmar cha'i ngo bo a shad lugs 'dir bam̐ yig gi rnal 'byor zhugs pa nang gi rnal 'byor mar brtags shing*/ de la brten nas pho nya gsum bsres sogs bshad gzhi rgya cher 'byung bas gtso bor rang sems gsang ba'i rnal 'byor mar shes dgos so zhes 'doms pa la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa ni/ gzhi skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba gdod ma'i gshis/ lam stong gsal brjod du bral ba gnyug ma phyag rgya chen po'i ngang*/ 'bras bu gzhan nas mi 'tshol bar gsal stong zung 'jug blo 'das rang sems rdo rje rnal 'byor mar de nyid rang ngo rang shes nas de'i rgyun rtag tu skyong bar shog ces pa'o// sh+lau ka bcu gcig pa rtsa rlung thig le zhes pa'i don ni bsam gyis mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa sogs kyi mthu las mthar thug gi bgrod bya smon lam gyis 'jug bsdu ba ste/ lus rtsa ngag rlung sems thig le'i rnal 'byor shar ba sku gsum gyi rang bzhin la/ de nyid shes rab e yig dang thabs bam̐ yig gi rnam pa ro rkyang gi rlung sems thig ler bcas dbu mar thim pas rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pa ngo bo nyid sku sems nyid bde chen chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin du sangs rgyas pa'i dpal 'byor gya nom par rang don du thob nas/

gzhan don du longs sprul gyi bkod pa bgrangs yas pa'i gzugs sku'i rnam rol grangs med kyis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i dngos brgyud kyi 'gro ba 'di dag rnam grol thar pa'i go 'phang la ma reg gi bar du brtse bas skyong bar shog ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// ༈ //zhar byung du mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam gyi dgongs 'grel yang bri bar bya ste/ na mo badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa li yi/ zhes nang gi rnal 'byor ma rdo rje gtum mo'i rang bzhin la mchod par brjod nas/ mtha' yas pa'i rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i rnam rol bde stong gi zlos gar ni/ srid pa 'khor ba dang zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul gyi mig 'phrul sgyu ma lta bu'i rol pa gdul bya'i snang ngor cir yang 'char ba las deng 'dir mkha' spyod kyi dpal mo yid 'ong ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod bdag gi snying nas dran no snyoms 'jug gi rol pas 'khyud pa'i rtse dgas skyongs shig ces pa ni sh+lau ka dang po'i don no// de yang 'og min gyi zhing na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs sku dus gsum gyi rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum mchog ma de dang*/ pū li ra ma la sogs pa 'dzam bu'i gling gi nyer bzhi'i yul dang gnas so gnyis na rang bzhin gyis bzhugs shing gnas pa'i bud med rnams ni zhing skyes kyi ḍā ki ma/ sprul pa'i sku nor 'dzin ste sa steng khyab pa'i bud med thams cad ni karma mu dra ste las kyi phyag rgya ma'am las las skyes pa/ de dag gi nang na ma mkha' 'gro ma yin pa'i bu mor skyes pa ni rigs las skyes pa/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi skyabs mchog rje btsun ma de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du bsgoms pa ni sngags las skyes zhes 'chad cing*/ de rnams sam+bu ṭa'i rgyud las gsungs pa ltar ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i phyag rgya dang phaiṃ zhes pa'i sgras pho nya gsum bsres tshul sogs man ngag gi rgya cher bshad pa sh+lau ka gnyis pa'i don no// de ltar du shar ba'i rnal 'byor ma khyod ni rang gi sems nyid stong pa'i rang rtsal du shar ba ste/

de yang rdo rje'i lus kyi grong khyer na nang gi rigs ldan ma rje btsun yum gyi ngo bo lte ba'i rtsa mdud gru gsum e yig gi dbyibs can gyi dbus na dmar cha'i ngo bo a thung skyer tsher shad kyi rnam pa can nang gi rnal 'byor ma bam̐ yig gi yi ge'i rang bzhin gyi dngos por gyur pa dang*/ de nyid phyi rol 'khor ba sgyu ma'i gling na 'ga' zhig tu 'jigs rung srin mo'i gzugs can tshar chen chos kyi rgyal por khro phu dang srin po rir zhal bstan pa'i tshul de bcu dang*/ la lar 'dzum dkar gyi rol pa g.yo ba'i bud med gzhon nu mdzes sdug gi lang tsho gsar par ston pa sogs tshul sna tshogs snang ngo*// zhes sh+lau ka gsum pa'i don no// de dag gis thabs dang sgo du mas phyi rol du ji ltar btsal yang 'phags ma khyod bden par grub pa'i nges pa cung zad kyang ma rnyed nas 'tshol ba'i spros pas dub pa'i sems gzhon nu de/ brjod bral dbu ma'i nags kyi khang bur ngal gso brten no// zhes bshad pa sh+lau ka bzhi pa'i don no// de lta bu'i rje btsun ma la e ma zhes gdung ba'i tshig gis drangs te da ni ye shes kyi ḍā ki khyed mi mngon mkha' spyod kyi dbyings nas bzhengs shig ces bskul nas he ru ka dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud kyi rgyal po rtsa rgyud dam/ bde mchog nyung ngu'i rgyud dam/ bde mchog bsdus pa'i rgyud le'u nga gcig yod pa'i le'u zhe brgyad pa las/ rdo rje btsun mo'i nye ba'i snying po mchog tu gyur pa 'di bzlas pa'am klag pas 'grub pa ces gsungs te/ sngags 'di bzlas pas 'grub pa ste/ las rnams kun byed dge ba yin// mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*// dum skyes ma dang la ma sogs// mkha' 'gro ma ni thams cad kyis// sngags ni 'di nyid yin par grags// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i bden pas skyongs shig ces sh+lau ka lnga pa'i don dang*/

sngon du 'phags ma 'dis rgya gar gyi grub chen rnams rjes su bzung ba'i tshul/ de yang shar phyogs bha drer 'khrungs shig dge slong paṇ+ḍi ta chen po yin pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos kyis rjes su bzung ste yul o rgyan bi shwa zhes bya ba'i bas mtha'i nags khrod zhig tu grub pa'i dbang po slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa zhes bya ba sgrub pa snying por mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ yul de'i rgyal po ri dwags bshor du byung bas mthong ste dka' thub kyis gzir ba'i lus 'tsho ba med pa snying rje skyes nas zas sbyin gyi grong khyer du 'dong zhes bsnyad de smras pa las/ slob dpon gyi rim pa gsum pa dam tshig gis phyag rgya man chad grub nas rim pa bzhi pa las rgya'i rten 'brel grub par gzigs nas/ dngos rnams yongs su shes pa'i mkhas pa rnams la brnyas par mi bya ste// de ni rtsa rtse chung ngu bas kyang chung ba'i 'byor pas 'khyigs pa min// rgyun mi 'chad par chang 'dzag pa yi 'gram slang nag por gyur pa yi// glang chen rnams ni pad+ma'i skud pa phra mos 'khyid pa mi nus bzhin// zhes tshigs su bcad pa gsungs shing*/ der rgyal po khros te yul de'i chang 'tshong ma zhig la bu mo pad+ma can gyi rigs zhig yod pa de la slob dpon dma' dbab par sgos te/ des kyang khas blangs shing bud med des slob dpon gyi zhabs tog byas pas snod ldan du gzigs ste phyag rgyar bzhes nas lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du bsgrub pa mdzad nas rim pa lnga pa mthar phyin nas yul de'i 'gro ba rnams rdo rje theg par bzud par dgongs te sprul pa'i bu dang bu mo yang sprul/ dus lan gcig gi tshe rgyal pos slob dpon grong khyer du tho mtshams pa'i phyir spyan drangs pas/ sras pho mo gnyis g.yas g.yon du khrid phyag rgyas mdun nas bdud rtsi 'dren pa rwa phor du gsol bzhin byon pa la/ rgyal pos mgo byas grong khyer pa rnams kyi sgo khang du sngar slob dpon gyi gsungs pa'i tshig bcad glur blangs te thal mo rdeb cing gad mos btab pas thugs khros pa ltar mdzad de/

rwa phor sa la brdab pas sa 'og rim bdun phug nas chu chen po btol/ slob dpon rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog he ru ka dang yum phag mor byas bu rdo rje dang bu mo dril bur bsgyur te phyag tu bsnams/ lhan skyes yab yum rnam par 'khyud pa dang tsum+bha'i brda te 'o bya ba dang snyoms 'jug gi bde bas rjes su bskyangs te kha sbyor mchog gi rol pas bskyangs te nam mkha' la gshegs pa bzhin bdag kyang skyongs shig ces sh+lau ka drug pa'i don yin cing*/ slob dpon 'di'i rnam thar rgyas pa rje btsun grags pas mdzad pa yod cing gzhan yang mang ngo*// de bzhin du gzhan yang gaṅgā'i gling du rje btsun ku sā li rjes su bzung ba'i lo rgyus kyang 'di ltar 'byung ste/ ma ga dha'i rgyal rigs kyi bu na lan+t+ra dge tshul byas pa dge tshul tshem bu par grags pa zhig slob dpon nag po spyod pa yul koṅka nar bzhugs pa'i rjes su 'brangs te dbang dang gdams pas rjes su bzung zhing lo bdun slob dpon gyi drung na gnas pa la/ nangs gcig sprin kha dog lnga dang nyi 'od char zim 'ja' tshon thams cad tshogs pa mthong ba'i rkyen gyis lhan cig skyes pa'i don bsgoms pas de rnams sgyu ma lta bur shar/ de'i rkyen gyis yang dag pa'i ye shes rtogs/ lta stongs brgyad sogs grub kyang thun mong gi grub thob mig ldan la sogs pa sgyu mas bslu ltar gzigs te shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa skyong bzhin bzhugs pa las/ dus lan cig slob dpon nag po spyod pa dang lhan cig shar phyogs la gshegs pas chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram nas mdze mo shin tu skyug bro ba zhig na re/ khyed rnams kyi nga chu bo 'di las sgrol nas grong 'dab zhig tu skyol zer ba la/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa sogs gzhan rnams kyis skyug bros bor/ dge tshul gyis grub thob 'di rgyab tu khur nas gaṅgā la skyal te song ba las chu'i dbus su slebs pa'i tshe tshem bu pa bde mchog dang mdze mo rnal 'byor mar gyur ku sā li tshem bu pa de nyid mngon sum du nam mkha'i dbyings su mkha' spyod la 'khrid pa ltar dang*/

dpal ldan nā ro ta pa ni kha che'i yul bram ze'i rigs las 'khrungs shing chung ngu nas mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi tar gyur pa/ slar sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa la zhugs te paṇ+ḍi ta chen por gyur/ na lan+d+ra dang bi kra ma shī li'i byang sgo bsrung zhing mu stegs rnams tshar gcod pa'i nyan bshad rgya cher mdzad skabs rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su zhal bstan cing rjes bzung ste grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po gyur cing nā ro mkha' spyod kyi zab lam 'di bal po pham thing pa sku mched sogs la bsten cing rgya bal bod gsum gyi paṇa grub mang po lam 'dis grol bar mdzad pa ltar/ bdag kyang dag pa mkha' spyod mchog tu dge ba'i grong khyer du 'khrid ces sh+lau ka bdun pa'i don/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa mchog de dag gi thugs rje'i mthu dang*/ gsang sngags bla na med pa ma'i rgyud sde chen po gsang mtha'i myur lam 'dis zab khyad dang*/ rnal 'byor bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ mkha' spyod dga' ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'dzum zhal dus ring por ma yin par myur du mthong bar shog ces sh+lau ka brgyad pa'i don yin no// de ltar zab mo'i lam gyi don 'grel pa// legs par bshad 'dis bdag sogs 'gro ba kun// srid lam ring por dub pa dbugs phyung nas// mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing der bgrod par shog /ces pa 'di yang thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i dge bshes dol chos 'khor gnas kyi chos 'chad pa'i slob dpon kun sdangs rab 'byams pa kun dga' dpal bzang gis nan btur chen pos bskul ba la brten nas/ thub bstan rdo rje brag gi chos smra ba'i dge slong bya bral ba pad+ma phrin las kyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong sman mchog gis bgyis pa dza yan+tu// ༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rgyun 'khyer dran gso gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hī ye/

rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs dang nyams khrid thob nas rgyun gyi nyams len gyi khrid ni/ sa chen gyis/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myang*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis rlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes don tshan bcu gcig las/ dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ gsum pa bdud rtsi myang ba rnams khrid yig tu gsal lo// nyams len dngos la/ bzhi pa tshad med ni skyabs yul gsal btab la/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs skyabs 'gro dang*/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs skyabs gsol/ bdag gi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis go 'phang thob par byas la/ zhes sogs kyis sems bskyed/ spro na rdor sems bsgom bzlas bya/ bsdu na ma byung yang 'thus/ lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ mdun gyis nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa sogs/ de dang 'brel ba'i brgyud 'debs ku sā li'i tshogs bsogs dang gsol 'debs sogs bya/ khrid yig tu gsum pa rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal sogs bshad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis su phye ba dang*/ zhal shes gsum sbyar ba sogs kyi khyad nas gsungs pa las rgyun gyi nyams len gong ltar yin/ drug pa bdag lhar bskyed pa ni/ bla ma 'od du zhu spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi snying gar e e las chos 'byung gru gsum sogs nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros te ba spu'i bu ga nas phar song rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs/

de thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur zhes pa'o// brgyad pa dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i phyag rgya smin mtshams su g.yon du skor zhing*/ phaiṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la zhes sogs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'i bar gyi pho nya gsum bsres dang ye shes pa bstim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dho sogs lan gsum phyag rgyar bcas te/ ye shes pa bcug pa'i rkyen gyis lus dkyil bsgom/ lus dkyil gyi khrid ma thob na dkyus la 'jug lus dkyil bsgom rjes shing gnyis gzer gcig gis bsdams pa'i dpe ltar go cha bkod pa ni/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo sogs dpa' mo'i go cha bcings/ dgu pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis kyi dang po ngag bzlas ni/ rang gi snying gar chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig la sngags phreng kha dog dmar pos g.yon skor du bskor ba zhes sogs nas/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar brjod la oṃ gsum ma'i bzlas pa bya/ gnyis pa yid bzlas ni/ rlung ro gsum bus rlung bzung zhing snying ga'i chos 'byung sngags phreng dang bcas pa lte bar phab la/ sngags phreng klog tshul du rlung bum can dang bstun pa'i yid bzlas bya/ yang rlung bzung la zhar byung rdzogs rim ni sngags phreng gi dmigs pa dor la/ chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhi'i g.yung drung dmar po bzhi g.yon skor du 'khor ba la sems gtad/ yang rlung bzung ste dbu ma'i mas sna'i dga' 'khyil dmar po g.yon du 'khor bzhin par snying ga'i thad du sleb pa dang*/ smin mtshams kyi dga' 'khyil dkar po g.yon du 'khor bzhin smin mtshams nas spyi gtsug gi bar gyen dang*/ de nas dbu ma'i nang du thur du 'khor bzhin snying ga'i dga' 'khyil dmar por bsam/

mthar dga' 'khyil gnyis reg la ma 'byar tsam drag tu 'khor ba'i mthar 'dres te mi dmigs par bsam la rlung bzung ngo*// skabs 'dir chos nyid dngos ston gyis byin brlabs dang*/ rtsa dbu ma'i khrid rgyas pa thob na bsgom/ bsdu na rje btsun yum gyi ti la ka'am dbu mar rlung sems bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor mar/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa ni rlung ro dgu bus la bum can gyi rlung dang bstun pa ci rigs bsgom/ de nas rlung lus la gnas pa bde ba bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ sems la zhugs pa stong pa bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis bsgom/ bcu pa bsam mi khyab la gnyis yod pa'i thun mong ma yin pa snyan brgyud ltar dang*/ thun mong ngag 'don kyi dkyus su yod pa'i snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum thams cad khyab/ ces sogs nas mi dmigs par gyur/ ces pa'i bar gyis rdzogs rim du bsdus la mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam sogs dge bsngo bya/ bcu gcig pa spyod lam gyis rnal 'byor ni rdzogs rim las lhar langs te 'khyer so gsum gyis rtsis zin pa'i spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor lnga dang*/ khyad par gtor ma'i rnal 'byor gyi gtor bsngo bya tshul sogs ngag 'don gyi dkyus ltar ro// khrid yig dang ngag 'don sogs gab dkrugs su bshad pa 'dir nyams len kho na khrigs chags su sdebs te rang gi nye gnas rgan po dge slong don ldan lam 'di'i rnal 'byor chags med du 'dug pa'i dran gsor dge slong bya bral ba pad+ma 'phrin las kyis gro bzhin can gyi mar ngo'i tshes bcur zin bris su bgyis pa'i dge des bdag gzhan thams cad mkha' spyod 'grub par shog/ ༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i nyams len snying por dril ba bzhugs so// ༈ /nā mo badz+ra yo gi nī bh+yaḥ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyis skyabs sems bya// rang gi snying gar e e las byung ba'i// chos 'byung brtsegs mar zla steng bam̐ dmar po// sngags phreng gis bskor 'od 'phros lus kun gang*// sgrib sbyangs 'od phung gyur las rang nyid ni// rnal 'byor dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// phyag g.yas gri gug 'thur brkyang g.yon thod pa// bdud rtsis gang ba gyen du phyogs pas gsol// g.yon gyi phrag par rdo rje'i kha ṭ+wāṃ brten// lang tsho dar bab dbu skra sil bur grol// phyag rgya lngas brgyan rnam snang cod pan can// g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum dus mtshan 'jigs byed mnan// pad+ma nyi ma'i dbus bzhugs lte ba ru// oṃ bam̐ dmar po snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngo// khar hriṃ moṃ dkar dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser// spyi bor hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu yan lag la// phaṭa phaṭa dud khas mtshan cing snying ga nas// 'od 'phros 'gro kun sgrib sbyangs rnal 'byor ma'i// skur gyur bam̐ las 'od 'phros bkug par gyur// phaiṃ brjod 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur// oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/

pad bskor nga rgyal bya/ snying gar chos 'byung brtsegs ster zla steng bam̐// sngags phreng gis bskor 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā// zhes bzlas bde stong rnal 'byor gzhan du shes// snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros khams gsum po// 'od kyi rnam par 'dus nas lus la thim// rim bzhin 'od zhu chos 'byung zla ba dang*// sngags 'phreng bam̐ yig nā da'i bar du thim// slar yang rnal 'byor ma yi sku ru gyur// 'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thog nas su// rol mo sil snyan sgra snyan sogs mchod cing*// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su khrid par shog /zhes chos mdzad phrin las kyi ngor 'gyur med rdo rjes so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
